content.text:
We need to place orders for round 2. Must assign exactly one order to each occupied area (controlled by us). Currently occupied areas are: pyke, ironmans-bay, port-of-pyke, greywater-watch (as per planningConstraints). Also, we may have units in other areas? Check board: Greyjoy units only in those four. Yes.

We have 0 starred orders allowed (maxStarredOrders 0). So all orders must be regular (non-starred). Need to assign one order per region.

We need to consider priorities and preferences. The strategicMemory commitments earlier had orders in round1: pyke defense, greywater-watch defense, port-of-pyke consolidate power, ironmans-bay consolidate power. Likely continue similar unless better.

We must consider supply: supply =2. Currently we have 2 units in pyke (footman, knight) -> 2 units in same area => army size 2. In ironmans-bay one ship. In port-of-pyke one ship. In greywater-watch one footman. That's three armies (pyke army size 2, ironmans-bay ship army size1, port-of-pyke ship army size1, greywater-watch footman alone not army). Supply 2 allows armies: from supply track 2 permits army sizes: 3,2,2 according to table? supply 2 => permitted army sizes 3,2,2. Means you can have up to 3 armies: one up to 3 units, two up to 2 units each. Currently we have 3 armies (pyke army of 2, ironmans-bay ship army of 1 (single unit not army?), single unit is not an army, so only 2 armies? Actually army defined as two or more units in same area. So only pyke counts as an army (size2). The ships are single units, not army. So supply fine.

Orders types: options: March (we have two March orders: -1 and +0) and a +1 special not allowed. Defense (two +1, one +2 starred). Support (two +0, one +1 starred). Consolidate Power (two normal, one starred). Raid (two normal, one starred). Need to pick appropriate.

Goal: expand toward Flint's Finger and Seagard via ship transport from pyke/ironmans-bay/greywater-watch.

We have a ship in ironmans-bay (adjacent to pyke? Actually ironmans-bay is sea adjacent to pyke? map: ironmans-bay is sea adjacent to pyke (land) and also to greywater-watch? ironmans-bay neighbours: flints-finger, greywater-watch, port-of-pyke, pyke, riverrun, seagard, sunset-sea, the-golden-sound. So ship can support movement.

We might want to use March orders to move units, maybe a March from pyke to attack Flint's Finger (castle) via ship transport? Actually pyke is land, adjacent sea ironmans-bay (contains our ship). To march from pyke to Flint's Finger (land castle) we need ship transport: we have a ship in ironmans-bay, and Flint's Finger is land neighbor of ironmans-bay (see map: flints-finger is land neighbor of ironmans-bay). So we can transport footman/knight from pyke via ship to Flint's Finger in one March order (the March token placed on pyke). That would capture castle if successful (no enemy units). So we likely want March at pyke (prefer +0 or -1?). No need combat strength, just moving. Use March +0 (order id 2) maybe. Defense on other areas to protect. Consolidate Power maybe on port-of-pyke to get power? Consolidate Power on sea gives no power, but on port also yields no power. So maybe better to use Raid on greywater-watch to disrupt others? Could raid adjacent support orders: what adjacent enemy orders exist? Need to check reveal orders currently none (revealedOrders empty). So raid would be wasted. So better use Defense to protect our units and maybe Support to bolster in future combats. Support token can be used in combats elsewhere but currently no combat, but still can be placed.

We have 4 areas, 5 regular March tokens? Actually each house has 2 March, 2 Defense, 2 Support, 2 Raid, 2 Consolidate Power. So total 10 regular orders. Need assign 4 orders, any mixture.

We must respect starred limit zero, so cannot use starred orders.

Probably assign:

- pyke: March +0 (to attempt capture Flint's Finger)
- greywater-watch: Support (to be ready to support attack from pyke or later)
- port-of-pyke: Consolidate Power (even though sea, but port? Port of pyke is a port area, not sea, contains our ship? Actually port-of-pyke currently has no ship? It has ship unit in board list? It lists port-of-pyke units: ship id 7. So we have ship in the port. Consolidate Power on a port yields no power, but it's okay. Alternatively Defense there to protect ship.

- ironmans-bay: Support or Defense? ironmans-bay has ship, maybe Defense to protect ship, but ship can't be attacked by land? It can be attacked by enemy ships or ground? Might be targeted. Defense gives +1 combat strength if attacked. Support could help later.

We also might want March from ironmans-bay to move ship elsewhere but not needed.

Consider supply: moving footman/knight from pyke will leave pyke with maybe only one unit (if we move both?). March order can move any number of units; we could move both footman and knight out, leaving pyke empty. Then we would need to place a Power token to retain control of pyke (castle). We cannot because we would need to establish control when vacating. We have 6 power tokens, could do that. But we might want to keep one unit to hold pyke. Maybe move only footman via ship transport to Flint's Finger, leaving knight behind to hold pyke castle. That would be an army of 1? Single unit -> not an army, fine. So we keep control without need for power token. So March order can move part.

Thus assign March to pyke.

Now other orders: we likely want Defense on greywater-watch to protect footman there. Also Defense on ironmans-bay to protect ship. Consolidate Power maybe on port-of-pyke (but gives no power) maybe we could use Support there instead. Since we have only two Defense tokens, we can use both.

We have 2 Defense normal (order id 4 and 5). Use them for pyke? but we need March there. So Defense on greywater-watch and ironmans-bay. Then we need two more orders: maybe Support on port-of-pyke and Consolidate Power on something else? But we have 4 areas only, each must get exactly one order. So assign:

- pyke: March +0
- greywater-watch: Defense +1
- ironmans-bay: Defense +1
- port-of-pyke: Support +0 (or Consolidate Power). Which is better? Support can be used to assist combats, but having a ship in port might be vulnerable; Defense gives extra combat bonus, but support may not defend. The port cannot be attacked directly (no combat). So Defense on port-of-pyke is not useful. So Support there could later support attacks from ironmans-bay into neighboring combats. So assign Support.

Thus orders: pyke March +0, greywater-watch Defense, ironmans-bay Defense, port-of-pyke Support.

Check starred limit: none starred.

Now we need to output JSON action to place orders. Need to follow schema used earlier: submit_orders with assignments list (region_id, preferred_order, starred_preference, priority). But now need to give final orders? The harness will allocate actual token IDs based on preferences. We just need to provide preferences.

Our preferences: preference names likely "march", "defense", "support", "consolidate_power", "raid". Use lower case as in previous assignments.

Starred_preference: "avoid" as we have 0 starred.

Priority number: we can set high for important, lower for less. For example, pyke priority 100, greywater-watch 80, ironmans-bay 70, port-of-pyke 60.

Provide ready flag? Not needed; just order assignments.

Schema maybe similar to previous "submit_orders". Let's output:

{
 "assignments": [
   {"region_id":"pyke","preferred_order":"march","starred_preference":"avoid","priority":100},
   {"region_id":"greywater-watch","preferred_order":"defense","starred_preference":"avoid","priority":80},
   {"region_id":"ironmans-bay","preferred_order":"defense","starred_preference":"avoid","priority":70},
   {"region_id":"port-of-pyke","preferred_order":"support","starred_preference":"avoid","priority":60}
 ]
}

But need to include action type? The system expects final answer matching response schema. In previous examples they used submit_orders action with assignments field. Likely we need to output:

{
 "action":"submit_orders",
 "assignments":[...]
}

But earlier history shows action call without "action" field, just the arguments? In the game, they used "submit_orders" as action type. The tool description: action "submit_orders" with arguments assignments. The final answer should be JSON with the required fields. Usually the expected schema: {"assignments":[...]} is enough? Need to check description: "Your final answer submits the whole order draft and marks your house ready." earlier they used submit_orders. In previous logs, the action was: {"assignments":[...]}. Probably the system will infer action type. Better include "assignments" key.

Thus final answer JSON.

The exact requested number of semantic order assignments.
Region IDs must be distinct. When there are fewer usable tokens than
occupied regions, choose which regions receive no order.

preferred_order.description: Preferred order category. The harness preserves this preference when the global physical-token inventory and Westeros restrictions permit it, and otherwise substitutes a legal category. The currently restricted categories are none.

starred_preference.description: Prefer a starred token when it is legal and available, or avoid one unless the order inventory forces it.
starred_preference.title: StarredPreference

priority.description: Relative importance from 0 to 100. Higher-priority regions receive scarce starred tokens and stronger March modifiers first.

actionOutputSchema.description: You are placing planning orders for this round. Assign an order preference to each required occupied area, respecting the displayed restrictions and starred-order limit. Your final answer submits the whole order draft and marks your house ready. These orders determine what your armies can do later; this decision does not move units. A single land unit can capture an empty castle with a March order. Defence and Support orders do not move that unit or claim neighbouring land. Consolidate Power in an open sea earns no power; a port follows the separate port rule. The harness allocates the physical order tokens, preserving higher-priority preferences when not all requested categories fit the available tokens.
